name: Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd.
summary: Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells refined sugar and functional food materials in Japan. It operates through the Sugar Business, Life Energy Business, and Real Estate Business segments. The Sugar Business manufactures and sells raw sugar, processed sugar, and sugar-related products; rock sugar, liquid sugar, brown crystal sugar, sugar stick sachets, powdered sugar, gum syrup, and soft drink concentrates; centrifugal sugar and black sugar; sweeteners and other food ingredients; and functional food.
